question.text: Internal bisector of $\angle A$ of $\triangle A B C$ meets side $B C$ at $D$. A line drawn through $D$ perpendicular to $A D$ intersects the side $A C$ at $E$ and side $A B$ at $F$. If $a, b$ and $c$ represent sides of $\triangle A B C$, then

options.text: the $\triangle A E F$ is isosceles
